# crosswork_data_gateway_instances (Data Source)

This data source fetches the Crosswork Data Gateway instances that are enrolled on the cluster, with the pool, the data gateway and the state of each. The instances are virtual machines that enrol themselves; Terraform cannot create them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_data_gateway_instances" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `items` (Attributes Set) List of the data gateway instances of the cluster (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `admin_state` (String) Administrative state of the instance, such as `AS_UP`
- `id` (String) Id of the instance
- `name` (String) Name of the instance
- `oper_state` (String) Operational state of the instance, such as `OS_UP`, `OS_NOT_READY` or `OS_ERROR`
- `pool_id` (String) Id of the pool of the instance, not set for an unassigned instance
- `role` (String) Role of the instance in its pool, `ASSIGNED`, `SPARE` or `UNASSIGNED`
- `vdg_id` (String) Id of the data gateway the instance is the active instance of, not set for a spare or an unassigned instance
